question: What sequence of acts must the guru perform using the heart-mantra?
premises: Bathing and related acts are performed.
Foot-water and related offerings are given with the heart-mantra.
inference: The guru, having performed bathing and so on and given foot-water and so on with the heart-mantra, proceeds with the rite.
plain_english: Having performed bathing and so on and given foot-water and so on with the heart-mantra, the guru should proceed.
